verses: Qasam hai aasman ki aur andheray mein roshan honey walay ki
Tujhay maloom bhi hai kay woh raat ko namodar honey wali cheez kiya hai?
Koi aisa nahi jiss per nigehbaan farishta na ho
Insan ko dekhna chahaiye kay woh kiss cheez say peda kiya gaya hai
Woh aik uchalty pani say peda kiya gaya hai
Jo peeth aur seenay kay darmiyan say nikalta hai
Be-shak woh ussay pher laney per yaqeenan qudrat rakhney wala hai
Jiss din posheedah bhedon ki jaanch partal hogi
To na hoga uss kay pass kuch zor na madadgar
Aur pahtney wali zamin ki qasam
Be-shak yeh (Quran) albatta do tok faisla kerney wala kalaam hai
Yeh hansi ki (aur bey faeedah) baat nahi
Albatta kafir dao ghaat mein hain
Aur mein bhi aik chaal chal raha hun
To kafiron ko mohlat dey unhen thoray dino chor dey
